The location of the townland is roughly contained within the R418 and R448 routes starting at its most northerly point, a crossroads known locally as Thompson's Cross.  The townland continues south from this point as far as Harklow and is intersected in its north east corner by the M9 motorway at Abbeyaun. [6] «Man of War, Fingal | Man Of War (also known as Man O' War) is a small populated place in Fingal, Ireland. Most of Tomregan's constituent townlands are situate in County Cavan, with the remainder in County Fermanagh.  The Roman Catholic parish of Tomregan was split up in the early 18th century, with the County Fermanagh townlands being assigned to the parish of Knockninny while the County Cavan townlands were united with the parish of Kildallan.
